const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Interactive one-episode controller for RoboTwin open_laptop."""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+print('SPEC', json.dumps(spec, indent=2), flush=True)
+print('STATUS', json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2), flush=True)
+obs = r.get_obs(include_depth=True, video='none')
+print('OBS META', json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
+for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+    Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f'initial_{cam}.png')
+for cam, dep in obs.depth.items():
+    np.save(OUT / f'initial_{cam}_depth.npy', dep)
+print('PROPRIO', json.dumps(obs.meta.get('proprio'), indent=2), flush=True)
+print('Ready. Enter Python statements; `obs = r.get_obs(...)` refreshes views.', flush=True)
+
+def observe(seconds=0.0, depth=True, video='none'):
+    global obs
+    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, include_depth=depth, video=video)
+    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f'latest_{cam}.png')
+    print('OBS', json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
+    print('PROPRIO now', json.dumps(obs.meta.get('proprio', {}).get('now')), flush=True)
+    return obs
+
+def ee(left=None, right=None, note=''):
+    """Submit one ee_pose waypoint; omitted arm holds its measured pose."""
+    global obs
+    p = obs.meta['proprio']['now']
+    l = list(left) if left is not None else list(p[14:21]) + [float(p[28])]
+    rr = list(right) if right is not None else list(p[21:28]) + [float(p[29])]
+    assert len(l) == 8 and len(rr) == 8
+    res = r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(l + rr, dtype=np.float32), video='both', note=note)
+    print('RESULT', json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
+    for cam, im in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f'after_{cam}.png')
+    obs = r.get_obs(include_depth=True, video='none')
+    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f'latest_{cam}.png')
+    print('PROPRIO now', json.dumps(obs.meta.get('proprio', {}).get('now')), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def joints(rows, dt=0.05, note=''):
+    """Submit joint position rows, shaped (T,14)."""
+    global obs
+    res = r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video='both', note=note)
+    print('RESULT', json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
+    for cam, im in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f'after_{cam}.png')
+    obs = r.get_obs(include_depth=True, video='none')
+    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f'latest_{cam}.png')
+    print('PROPRIO now', json.dumps(obs.meta.get('proprio', {}).get('now')), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+while True:
+    try:
+        line = input('rcb> ')
+    except EOFError:
+        break
+    if line.strip() in ('quit', 'exit'):
+        break
+    try:
+        exec(line, globals(), globals())
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(type(exc).__name__, str(exc), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
